page.layout: Running head at top: printed page number left, title centred. Below it, two parallel columns: Greek on the left, Latin on the right (3 lines). Then one column of running text with Greek inline. Then a verse epigram set in indented lines. Then a closing paragraph at full width. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Si quis in iudicio proditionis aut sacri-legij damnatus fuerit, intra Atticam ne sepelitor, bona eius publicantor.

Legem retulit Xenophon [illegible, ~35 letters] Libro I. [illegible, ~25 letters] Cùm autem accusati fuerant proditionis, quanquā nondum essent conuicti, in vinculis habebantur, vt constat è iureiurando Senatus Quingentorum apud Demosthenem in Timocratea: [illegible, ~60 letters].

Atque id, vt dixi, intelli-gendum est statim ab accusatione proditionis in vinculis habitos fuisse, antequam criminis illius fuissent conuicti: nam postquam rei peracti fuerant, non est mirum: explicat statim Demosthenes: [illegible, ~30 letters]. Atque hi qui proditionis accusabantur, in vinculis caufam dicebant, vt ex his liquet, & Canoni psephismate, quod legitur apud Xenophontem loco laudato, [illegible, ~45 letters]. Morte autem luebant. De sacrilegis manifestis Xenophon Libro I. [illegible, ~40 letters]. De proditoribus constat è Lycurgo [illegible, ~20 letters] corumque cadauera [illegible, ~15 letters]. Thucydides de The-mistocle Libro I. [illegible, ~80 letters]. Cenotaphia tamen poterant illis extrui intra Atticae fines, sed im-posita tumulo cruce: idque obseruat Marcellinus in vita Thucydidis profugi ad proditionis crimen: [illegible, ~110 letters]. Quod in hostium tumulis obseruasse videntur Graeci: nam huc refero ea, quae à Tito Quinto Flaminio in Epigrammate dicuntur aduersus Alcaeum Poetam, qui gloriam fugati Philippi Macedonum Regis suis adscribebat Ætolis, hoc item Epigrammate:
Refcripsit enim Flaminius in his tumulis paratam esse Alcaeo crucem, nempe propter illa impia, quae hostium tumulis imponebantur, & crucis vicem prae-stare poterant: [illegible, ~50 letters].

page.notes: The Greek text is small and blurred at this scan resolution, so I could not read it letter by letter and have marked it illegible throughout rather than guess. The Latin is transcribed from the scan. Hyphenation at "The-mistocle" is uncertain. The faint marks at the bottom right are a digitiser's stamp and were left out.
